questions.prompt:
Complete the matrix. In each row, the right cell adds one open shape of the same kind.
Row 1: ○ ○ | ○ ○ ○
Row 2: △ △ △ | ?
questions.explanation: The right cell contains exactly one more open shape, so three triangles become four.

questions.prompt:
Complete the matrix. Down each column, the lower arrow points in the opposite direction.
Top row: ↑ | ←
Bottom row: ↓ | ?
questions.explanation: The direction opposite ← is →.

questions.prompt:
Complete the matrix. Each row changes an open shape to its filled form and places a + after it.
Row 1: ○ | ● +
Row 2: □ | ?
questions.explanation: The open square becomes filled and is followed by a plus sign.

questions.prompt:
Complete the matrix. In each row, the third cell superimposes the first two symbols.
Row 1: |  and  -  gives +
Row 2: /  and  \  gives ?
questions.explanation: Superimposing the two diagonals / and \ forms ×.

questions.prompt:
Complete the matrix. From left to right, the filled shape moves one position downward in a three-position column, wrapping after the bottom.
Cell 1: Top ●; middle ○; bottom ○
Cell 2: Top ○; middle ●; bottom ○
Cell 3: ?
questions.correctAnswer: Top ○; middle ○; bottom ●
questions.explanation: The filled circle moves from top to middle to bottom.

questions.prompt: A rectangular paper is folded from bottom to top along the horizontal centerline. One hole is punched near the upper-left corner of the folded rectangle, away from all edges. What appears after unfolding?

choices.A: One hole near the upper-left corner
choices.B: Two holes aligned vertically on the left side
choices.C: Two holes aligned horizontally across the top
choices.D: Four holes, one near each corner

questions.correctAnswer: Two holes aligned vertically on the left side
questions.explanation: The horizontal fold reflects the punch vertically, producing two left-side holes at matching heights.

questions.prompt: A square paper is folded from left to right, then a hole is punched on the folded paper’s right outer edge, halfway between top and bottom. What appears after unfolding?

choices.B: Two holes on the vertical centerline
choices.C: Two holes, one on each outer side edge
choices.D: Four holes, one near each corner

questions.correctAnswer: Two holes, one on each outer side edge
questions.explanation: The punch on the outer edge reflects to the opposite outer edge after the vertical unfold.

questions.prompt: A square is folded from top to bottom and then folded again from top to bottom. A hole is punched near the center of the folded strip, away from every edge. What appears after unfolding?

choices.A: Two holes in one vertical column
choices.B: Four holes in one vertical column
choices.D: Two holes in one horizontal row

questions.correctAnswer: Four holes in one vertical column
questions.explanation: Two horizontal folds create four vertically reflected positions when reversed.

questions.prompt: A square is folded once along the diagonal from lower-left to upper-right. A small cut is made on the diagonal folded edge, away from both corners. What appears after unfolding?

choices.A: Four cuts at the outer corners
choices.B: Two cuts on the left edge
choices.C: A symmetric opening centered on that diagonal
choices.D: One cut only on the lower half

questions.correctAnswer: A symmetric opening centered on that diagonal
questions.explanation: A cut on the fold reflects across the diagonal and forms one symmetric opening centered on it.

questions.prompt:
The following arrangements share one rule:
1. ○ inside □, with + outside
2. △ inside ◇, with + outside
3. ☆ inside ○, with + outside
Which choice follows the same rule?
questions.correctAnswer: □ inside △, with + outside
questions.explanation: Each arrangement has one open shape inside a different open shape and a plus sign outside.

questions.prompt:
The following groups share one rule:
1. ↑ ↑ ↓
2. ← ← →
3. ↓ ↓ ↑
Which choice follows the same rule?
questions.explanation: The first two arrows match, and the third points in the opposite direction.

questions.prompt:
The following figures share one rule:
1. Outer □; inner ■; four + signs outside
2. Outer △; inner ▲; three + signs outside
3. Outer ◇; inner ◆; four + signs outside
Each open polygon contains its filled form and has one + for each corner. Which choice follows the rule?
questions.correctAnswer: Outer △; inner ▲; three + signs outside
questions.explanation: The triangle is open outside, filled inside, and accompanied by three plus signs for its three corners.

questions.prompt:
Complete the matrix. Across each row, the right cell reverses the order of three symbols.
Row 1: ○ △ □ | □ △ ○
Row 2: + ★ ◇ | ?
questions.explanation: Reversing +, ★, ◇ gives ◇, ★, +.

questions.prompt:
Complete the matrix. Down each column, one symbol is removed.
Top-left: ○ ○ ○
Bottom-left: ○ ○
Top-right: △ △
Bottom-right: ?
questions.explanation: The lower cell contains one fewer matching open symbol, so two triangles become one triangle.

questions.prompt:
Complete the matrix. Each row alternates open, filled, open versions of one shape.
Row 1: ○ | ● | ○
Row 2: □ | ■ | ?
questions.explanation: The square row must finish with the open square, matching the open-filled-open pattern.

questions.prompt:
Complete the matrix. From left to right, the line rotates 45° clockwise.
Row: |  then  /  then  ?
questions.explanation: After vertical | rotates 45° clockwise to /, another 45° clockwise rotation gives horizontal -.

questions.prompt: A square paper is folded from right to left. Two holes are punched in the folded paper, one near the top and one near the bottom, both away from edges. What appears after unfolding?

choices.A: Four holes in one horizontal row
choices.B: Four holes forming two horizontal pairs
choices.C: Two holes in one vertical line

questions.correctAnswer: Four holes forming two horizontal pairs
questions.explanation: The vertical unfold mirrors each of the two punches, producing two horizontal pairs and four holes total.

questions.prompt: A rectangular paper is folded from top to bottom. A triangular cut is made on the folded paper’s left outer edge, away from the fold and corners. What appears after unfolding?

choices.A: Two cuts on opposite side edges
choices.B: One cut on the left edge
choices.C: Two matching cuts on the left edge, mirrored vertically
choices.D: Four cuts, one on each corner

questions.correctAnswer: Two matching cuts on the left edge, mirrored vertically
questions.explanation: The horizontal unfold reflects the edge cut to a second location on the same left outer edge.

questions.prompt: A square is folded left to right, then bottom to top. A hole is punched on the folded paper’s vertical outer edge, away from corners and fold lines. What appears after unfolding?

choices.A: Two holes on one outer edge
choices.B: Four holes, two on each opposite vertical edge
choices.C: Eight holes around all four edges

questions.correctAnswer: Four holes, two on each opposite vertical edge
questions.explanation: The horizontal fold doubles the hole vertically, and the vertical fold mirrors both to the opposite outer edge.

questions.prompt: A square is folded along the diagonal from upper-right to lower-left. Two holes are punched away from all edges at different distances from the fold. What appears after unfolding?

choices.C: Four holes forming two mirrored pairs across the diagonal

questions.correctAnswer: Four holes forming two mirrored pairs across the diagonal
questions.explanation: Each off-fold punch reflects once across the diagonal, producing two mirrored pairs and four holes.

questions.prompt:
The following arrangements share one rule:
1. Left ○; center +; right ●
2. Left □; center +; right ■
3. Left △; center +; right ▲
Which choice follows the same rule?
questions.correctAnswer: Left ◇; center +; right ◆
questions.explanation: An open shape appears left of + and its matching filled form appears right of +.

questions.prompt:
The following groups share one rule:
1. ○ ■ +
2. ■ + ○
3. + ○ ■
Each group contains exactly one open circle, one filled square, and one plus sign. Which choice follows the same rule?
questions.explanation: Choice D contains exactly one open circle, one filled square, and one plus sign.

questions.prompt:
The following pairs share one rule:
1. ↑ becomes ←
2. → becomes ↑
3. ↓ becomes →
Which choice follows the same rule?
questions.correctAnswer: ← becomes ↓
questions.explanation: Each arrow rotates 90° counterclockwise; ← therefore becomes ↓.

questions.prompt:
The following figures share one rule:
1. ○ outside □, with one + inside □
2. △ outside ◇, with one + inside ◇
3. ☆ outside ○, with one + inside ○
Which choice follows the same rule?
questions.correctAnswer: ◇ outside △, with + inside △
questions.explanation: An open shape stands outside a different open shape that contains one plus sign.

questions.prompt:
Complete the matrix. In each row, the right cell contains the two symbols from the left cell with their positions exchanged.
Row 1 left: Top ○; bottom ■
Row 1 right: Top ■; bottom ○
Row 2 left: Top △; bottom ◆
Row 2 right: ?
questions.correctAnswer: Top ◆; bottom △
questions.explanation: Exchanging the top and bottom positions places ◆ above △.

questions.prompt:
Complete the matrix. Across each row, the number of shapes increases by two.
Row 1: ○ | ○ ○ ○
Row 2: □ □ | ?
questions.explanation: Increasing two squares by two gives four open squares.

questions.prompt:
Complete the matrix. Down each column, a + changes to × while the accompanying shape remains unchanged.
Top-left: ○ +
Bottom-left: ○ ×
Top-right: □ +
Bottom-right: ?
questions.explanation: The square stays open while + changes to ×.

questions.prompt:
Complete the matrix. Across each row, the arrow turns 180° and the open shape becomes filled.
Row 1: ↑ ○ | ↓ ●
Row 2: ← □ | ?
questions.explanation: A 180° turn changes ← to →, and open □ becomes filled ■.

questions.prompt:
Complete the matrix. In each row, the third cell contains the symbol common to the first two cells.
Row 1: {○, □} | {□, △} | □
Row 2: {+, ★} | {★, ×} | ?
questions.explanation: The only symbol shared by the two Row 2 sets is ★.

questions.prompt: A square is folded from left to right. A hole is punched exactly on the horizontal centerline of the folded rectangle, away from edges and the vertical fold. What appears after unfolding?

choices.A: One hole on the vertical fold
choices.C: Two holes in a vertical column
choices.D: Two holes in a horizontal row, symmetric across the vertical centerline

questions.correctAnswer: Two holes in a horizontal row, symmetric across the vertical centerline
questions.explanation: The vertical unfold mirrors the off-fold punch horizontally; its centerline height remains unchanged.

questions.prompt: A rectangle is folded from right to left, then from top to bottom. A hole is punched near the lower-left corner of the folded rectangle, away from all edges. What appears after unfolding?

choices.A: Two holes on the left side
choices.B: Four holes on the horizontal centerline
choices.C: Four holes, one in each corresponding quadrant

questions.correctAnswer: Four holes, one in each corresponding quadrant
questions.explanation: Two perpendicular folds reflect the punch across both centerlines, producing four corresponding positions.

questions.prompt: A square is folded once from bottom to top. A semicircular cut is made on the folded paper’s top outer edge, away from corners. What appears after unfolding?

choices.A: One complete circle at the horizontal centerline
choices.B: Two complete circles in a vertical column
choices.C: Two matching semicircular cuts, one on the top edge and one on the bottom edge
choices.D: One semicircle on the bottom edge

questions.correctAnswer: Two matching semicircular cuts, one on the top edge and one on the bottom edge
questions.explanation: The outer-edge cut reflects across the horizontal centerline to the opposite outer edge.

questions.prompt: A square is folded from left to right. The resulting rectangle is then folded along its diagonal from lower-left to upper-right, bringing its upper-left corner onto its lower-right corner. One hole is punched away from all edges and fold lines. What appears after fully unfolding?

choices.B: Two holes on the original diagonal
choices.D: Four holes related by the two fold reflections

questions.correctAnswer: Four holes related by the two fold reflections
questions.explanation: Each of the two folds doubles the off-edge punch, yielding four reflected positions.

questions.prompt:
The following arrangements share one rule:
1. ○ above □, with a vertical line between them
2. △ above ◇, with a vertical line between them
3. ☆ above ○, with a vertical line between them
Which choice follows the same rule?

choices.A: □ above △, with a vertical line between
choices.B: ◇ above △, with a horizontal line between
choices.C: ■ above □, with a vertical line between
choices.D: ○ beside □, with a vertical line between

questions.correctAnswer: □ above △, with a vertical line between
questions.explanation: Two different open shapes are arranged vertically with a vertical line between them.

questions.prompt:
The following sequences share one rule:
1. ○ □ △
2. □ △ ○
3. △ ○ □
Which choice follows the same rule?
questions.explanation: Each listed sequence follows the same cyclic order ○, □, △; choice A is one of those valid rotations.

questions.prompt:
The following figures share one rule:
1. Outer ○; two identical + signs inside
2. Outer □; two identical × signs inside
3. Outer △; two identical ★ signs inside
Which choice follows the same rule?
questions.correctAnswer: Outer ◇; two identical ○ signs inside
questions.explanation: An open outer shape contains exactly two identical symbols.

questions.prompt:
The following arrangements share one rule:
1. Left ●; right ○
2. Left ■; right □
3. Left ▲; right △
Which choice follows the same rule?
questions.correctAnswer: Left ★; right ☆
questions.explanation: The filled form appears on the left and its matching open form appears on the right.

questions.prompt:
Complete the matrix. From left to right, one symbol moves from outside the square to inside it.
Cell 1: + + outside □; none inside
Cell 2: + outside □; + inside □
Cell 3: ?
questions.correctAnswer: No + outside □; two + inside □
questions.explanation: One plus moves inside at each step, so the last cell has both plus signs inside and none outside.

questions.prompt:
Complete the matrix. Across each row, both arrows rotate 90° clockwise.
Row 1: ↑ ↓ | → ←
Row 2: ← → | ?
questions.explanation: Rotating ← clockwise gives ↑, and rotating → clockwise gives ↓.

questions.prompt:
Complete the matrix. In each row, the right cell removes the filled shape and duplicates the open shape.
Row 1: ○ ● | ○ ○
Row 2: □ ■ | ?
questions.explanation: Removing ■ and duplicating □ produces two open squares.

questions.prompt:
Complete the matrix. Down each column, the top and bottom symbols combine by placing the bottom symbol inside the top symbol.
Top-left: ○
Bottom-left: +
Result-left: + inside ○
Top-right: □
Bottom-right: ×
Result-right: ?
questions.correctAnswer: × inside □
questions.explanation: The bottom symbol × is placed inside the top symbol □.

questions.prompt: A square is folded from top to bottom. Two holes are punched near the folded paper’s left and right sides at the same height, away from edges. What appears after unfolding?

choices.A: Four holes in one vertical column
choices.B: Two holes on the horizontal centerline
choices.C: Four holes forming the corners of a rectangle

questions.correctAnswer: Four holes forming the corners of a rectangle
questions.explanation: Each punch reflects vertically, producing two upper and two lower holes arranged as a rectangle.

questions.prompt: A rectangle is folded from left to right. A narrow rectangular notch is cut from the folded paper’s top outer edge, away from corners. What appears after unfolding?

choices.A: One notch at the top center
choices.B: Four notches, one on each side
choices.C: Two notches on opposite top and bottom edges
choices.D: Two matching notches on the top edge, mirrored left-to-right

questions.correctAnswer: Two matching notches on the top edge, mirrored left-to-right
questions.explanation: The vertical unfold mirrors the top-edge notch to a second position on the same top edge.

questions.prompt: A square is folded bottom to top and then right to left. A hole is punched on the folded paper’s horizontal outer edge, away from corners and fold lines. What appears after unfolding?

choices.A: Two holes on the top outer edge
choices.C: Four holes, two on each opposite horizontal edge

questions.correctAnswer: Four holes, two on each opposite horizontal edge
questions.explanation: The vertical fold doubles the punch sideways, and the horizontal fold mirrors both to the opposite horizontal edge.

questions.prompt: A square is folded once along the diagonal from lower-left to upper-right. Three holes are punched away from all edges and from one another. What appears after unfolding?

choices.A: Six holes forming three mirrored pairs across the diagonal

questions.correctAnswer: Six holes forming three mirrored pairs across the diagonal
questions.explanation: Each of three off-fold punches reflects once, producing six holes in three mirrored pairs.

questions.prompt:
The following arrangements share one rule:
1. ○ + □
2. △ + ◇
3. ☆ + ○
Which choice follows the same rule?
questions.explanation: Two different open shapes appear with a plus sign between them.

questions.prompt:
The following figures share one rule:
1. Outer □; inside ○ at top-left
2. Outer ◇; inside △ at top-left
3. Outer ○; inside ☆ at top-left
Which choice follows the same rule?
questions.correctAnswer: Outer △; inside □ at top-left
questions.explanation: An open shape contains a different open shape positioned at the top-left.

questions.prompt:
The following sequences share one rule:
1. + ○ + □
2. + △ + ◇
3. + ☆ + ○
Which choice follows the same rule?
questions.explanation: The sequence alternates plus signs with two different open shapes, beginning with +.

questions.prompt:
The following arrangements share one rule:
1. Top ●; bottom □
2. Top ■; bottom △
3. Top ▲; bottom ◇
Which choice follows the same rule?
questions.correctAnswer: Top ◆; bottom ○
questions.explanation: A filled shape is above a different open shape.

questions.prompt:
The following groups share one rule:
1. ○ ○ ●
2. □ □ ■
3. △ △ ▲
Which choice follows the same rule?
questions.explanation: Each group has two matching open shapes followed by one filled version of that same shape.
